{% raw %}
`/my-profile` shows your character and the settings you control. Only you see it, and every change saves as soon as you make it.

It opens on the **Core** tab: your attendance over the last 30 days, your leave, previous leagues and referral. If your server plays a game Alagos supports, a tab named after the game holds that game's details. With more than one game, that tab is called **Game** and has a menu to pick the game. The **Notifications** tab chooses which messages Alagos sends you.

**Not claimed your character yet?** You can still open `/my-profile` and set your notifications. Everything else needs your character first (see [**Claiming your character**](/guides/claiming/)).

## Notifications

Alagos can send you a private message (a DM) about things that concern you. Everything is **on** to start with:

- **Event reminders**: shortly before an event you said you will attend.
- **Event moved or cancelled**: when an event you signed up for (Will Attend or Tentative) changes time or is cancelled.
- **Off the bench**: when you move up from a role's bench into a slot.
- **Claim decisions**: when an officer approves or denies your character claim.
- In a server playing DC Dark Legion, **Train seat** and **Guardian post**: your seat or post, once the officers have marked it assigned in the game. These need a claimed character (they show 🔒 until then).

Press **✏️ Choose notices** to tick the ones you want. A kind marked ⛔ has been switched off for the whole server by its officers.

- **🌙 Quiet hours**: press **Change** and give two times, such as 22:00 and 08:00. A message that would arrive in between waits until they end. Add your own timezone if it is not the server's (for example `Europe/London`). Leave both times empty to remove them.
- **⏸️ Pause all** stops every message until you press **▶ Resume**. Paused messages are not saved up for later.

Every message has a **Stop these** button that switches that kind off, and a message about an event has **Not for this event**. At most 10 messages a day come from one server.

**Your DMs must be open.** If Discord refuses a message because your DMs are closed to the server, Alagos stops trying for a week. To allow them: right-click the server icon, **Privacy Settings**, turn on **Direct Messages**.

## Your loot points

If your server keeps loot with Alagos, the **Core** tab shows your balance in each points pool, and how many items you received in the others. **History** shows what is behind it: every points line (what you earned, for which event, any adjustment with its reason), and the items you received, with the reason the officers gave. Only you and your officers can see the details; the server's points board shows everyone's balance.

## Going on leave

Press **Change** beside **On leave**, then **Set on leave**. You can also pick how many days you expect to be away (3, 7, 14, 30 or 60), which sets you on leave too.

While you are on leave, the league's rotations and team lists leave you out, and you keep your usual place for when you are back. Press **Clear leave** when you return.

## Previous leagues and who referred you

Press **Edit** beside these to record leagues you played in before (separated by commas), and to pick the player who brought you in. Officers use this to know the league's history.

## What you cannot change here

Whether you are active on the roster, and any game details such as power or rank, are kept by the officers. Ask one if something is wrong.

## In a server playing DC Dark Legion

The **DC Dark Legion** tab shows your power and rank (kept by your officers) and has:

- **Train seats**: your preferred and alternate carriage for the daily train.
- **Events and Krypton Rush times**: the events you can usually make, and which Krypton Rush times suit you.

## Other ways in

If your officers have put up the **member panel**, its **My profile** button opens the same thing. You can also right-click your own name, then **Apps → View profile**. Right-clicking someone else's name and choosing **View profile** shows their character, as the roster does.

## More than one character?

If you have claimed more than one, `/my-profile` asks which one to open.

## Your characters: main and alts

Each game's tab has **👤 My characters**: your main and your alts in that game. Pick one to see its details, **✏️ Edit** the ones that are yours to change, or **⭐ Make my main**.

Whether you can **add** characters yourself depends on the game and your server: in some, members add their own (and their alts); in some, a new character waits for an officer to approve it (you are told when they decide); in others, officers add them all. DC Dark Legion starts with officers adding them. If your server lets members add their own and you are not on the roster yet, the **Core** tab offers **➕ Add my character**: adding your first one puts you on the roster, and it becomes your main. You can remove an alt; to remove your main, make another one your main first.
